content: I am writing this to publically call out Ajio for highly unethical business practices and terrible customer service.Here is what happened:The Issue: I placed an order and made a full prepayment.The Delay: Ajio held onto my money and kept the order accepted for 7 full days.The Cancelation: After a week of waiting, they abruptly canceled my order without my consent.The Impact: This is a clear breach of trust, holding customer funds interest-free while failing to deliver promised goods.Taking money
